notes.title: NEW SCENE!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Friends, (this update broke the game. But we fixed it. We apologize for the inconvenience. Reload Steam and update the game)[/h1][h1]
[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45368356/71c280c3385ede2691e8127a48d94507be61f91e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][i]We have added a new small sex scene to the [u]first maze![/u] Unfortunately, there is still no voiceover for this scene (our sound specialist has been ill), but the voiceover will be added later.[/i] 
[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45368356/631e594949b1a0fcd1a1a451496f0c7b7c487158.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][i]
We plan on continuing to add [u]new scenes in the future.[/u] And, after a [u]few more weeks[/u], maybe two, we will add a fork in the game that allows you to [u]choose a show leader[/u] after the second maze.[/i]
[/h2][p][/p][h2][u]Thank you for your patience! We appreciate your support.[/u][/h2]

notes.title: Gallery and Important News!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Friends,
[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45368356/817e001ef1db3acbefaa3c280fc32b0d5dd83819.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][i]We regret to inform you that due to some recent circumstances, we have been forced to remove certain scenes and apply censorship. [/i][/h2][p][/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45368356/f705268eae633e48c8d7ba3d67d2aa488eb0f2a0.jpg"][/img][/h2][p][/p][h2][i]Unfortunately, some of the censorship has been applied automatically even to scenes that did not require it. We are working to fix this issue.[/i]
[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45368356/45389df1fbcf640971edd6b5c59d31b347bc8c26.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][u][b]Additionally, because of these circumstances, we had to remove the gallery and start over. The gallery will become available again in the near future.
[/b][/u][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45368356/6beb383043dd96e06465176ba9140eb9f2395368.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][i]Your support is greatly appreciated at this time. We hope that we can resolve any issues in the future![/i] [/h2][p][/p][h1]Thank you for your patience and understanding.  [/h1]

notes.title: Release!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Dear friends,[/b]

I'm sorry to inform you that the internet has been temporarily unavailable in my area due to concerns regarding drones. As a result, I had to request another developer to publish an older build. This version contains a bug that prevents the game from starting + some audio bug. 

To start the game, please navigate to the "CHAPTERS" section in the main menu, which is represented by circles at the top.

Unfortunately, I am still unable to upload any new content. I have transferred the necessary permissions to my colleague, who will be uploading a new build soon. This build will be free from the bug.

[b][i][u]Thank you for your patience and understanding.[/u][/i][/b]

[/h2]
